hypothesis: the absence of task completion at 5000 steps is primarily severe undertraining rather than a structural inability to select and compose button presses
exact_change: increase optimizer steps from 5000 to 50000; preserve action_weight 10 and every other data, architecture, objective, optimizer, schedule, seed, and validation setting
expected_if_true: offline action calibration remains acceptable and deterministic task-4 evaluation improves mean best goal fraction by at least 0.0625 or achieves at least one full success
expected_if_false: offline calibration degrades or best task progress remains below 0.625 with zero successes

task.goal_relabeling: deterministic future state from the same episode only

acceptance.training_integrity: exit zero, exactly 50000 steps, finite logs and checkpoint tensors, no CUDA OOM, live and EMA weights saved
acceptance.offline_calibration_guardrail: first-action step clip fraction at most 0.20 and raw action MAE at most 0.30 on the frozen 128 windows
acceptance.task_progress_signal: mean best goal fraction at least 0.625 or at least one full success on seeds 82000-82002
acceptance.full_500k_gate: do not start 500k unless integrity and offline guardrail pass and task progress signal is met

compute_gate.execution: sole GPU job on one RTX 4080
